visual_review.review_method: Three fresh read-only visual contexts reviewed byte-bounded JPEG proxies for physical pages 1-14, 15-28, and 29-41 and returned text-only reports to the root context.
visual_review.transport_guard: No original PDF-page PNG or contact sheet was returned to the root context; each visual context used at most eight JPEG proxies of 450000 bytes or less.
findings: Physical page 1 is a populated MCM Summary Sheet with text and two comparison figures, not a blank page; its empty text file is a complete text-layer omission.
Physical pages 2-41 contain the forty numbered paper pages and were reviewed in order for formulas, figures, tables, captions, pagination, clipping, overlap, and extraction mismatch.
Mathematical symbols, smart punctuation, subscripts, inequalities, Greek letters, and several table structures are corrupted in extracted text but legible in the rendered pages.
No page has black blocks, clipped body text, or overlapping content; recurring layout weaknesses are small figure labels and multi-page tables without repeated headers.

The visual review distinguishes extraction defects from source-paper defects, including the link-budget constant, unit conversions, capacity notation, tree edge-removal rule, probability-model naming, and separated Figure 15 caption.

warnings: Physical page 1 has no extracted text despite containing a full Summary Sheet and two figures; downstream learning must use the rendered page for that page.
Formula and symbol transcription must be reconciled against rendered pages because OCR/text extraction corrupts pi, Phi, Omega, xi, inequalities, primes, subscripts, and proof symbols.
Several source-paper equations and claims contain confirmed substantive inconsistencies; these are retained in the final warning pass rather than treated as extraction errors.
